title: Facebook Ad Library Scraper Input
description: Low-cost sample: search active Nike ads in the US, save 1 result, and use Residential proxy. Increase max results only after the sample output looks right.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Search keywords to find public ads in the Facebook Ad Library. Start with one keyword. Up to 5 keywords per run.

pageIds.title: Page IDs
pageIds.description: Numeric Facebook Page IDs to scrape directly. Use one Page ID for a controlled test. Up to 5 Page IDs per run.

advertiserNames.title: Advertiser or page names
advertiserNames.description: Advertiser or Facebook Page names to search in the public Ad Library. Up to 5 names per run.

country.title: Country
country.description: Country filter. Use a two-letter ISO code such as US, GB, DE, IN, or ALL.

adCategory.title: Ad category
adCategory.description: Filter by Meta Ad Library category.

adStatus.title: Ad status
adStatus.description: Filter by active or inactive ads. Active is recommended for the first run.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Platforms where the ad is displayed. Keep Facebook and Instagram for the first run.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Maximum number of ads to save per search query. Start with 1 for a low-cost test. The actor supports up to 1000 ads per query.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy settings for the crawler. Residential proxy is recommended for Facebook Ad Library reliability.
